name: release-brief
title: Internal release readiness brief
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM releases ORDER BY name

sections.title: Scope and ownership
sections.sql: SELECT reference,name,status,owner,effort_days FROM features WHERE release_id=$1 ORDER BY reference

name: decision-record
title: Product decision record
for_each: SELECT id,reference FROM features ORDER BY reference

sections.title: Decision history
sections.sql: SELECT revision,outcome,reason,actor,created_at FROM decisions WHERE feature_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at

sections.title: Feedback review
sections.sql: SELECT organisation,purpose,review_on,legal_hold FROM feedback WHERE feature_id=$1 ORDER BY organisation
